concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-graphql-integration-guides-account-onboarding]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree website GraphQL guide for select-merchant partner account applications covering Account Manager and Control Panel credential setup, underwriting submission, nested business/payout-method input roles, and validation examples; an account-request ID is not biller approval, account activation, payment processing, payout execution, environment enablement, SDK support or exact-commit schema proof
warnings: Keep this partner GraphQL account-onboarding route distinct from the legacy Braintree Marketplace Node onboarding flow; the raw names billers, franchisees, and sub-merchants but does not identify the product as Marketplace.
The raw does not state sandbox or production; preserve environment qualification and do not infer operation enablement from Control Panel login credentials.
